run_test_memnn_labelcands_nomemnn: run the test_labelcands_nomemnn test to verify memnn model learns basic single-turn tasks with hits@1 above 0.95
run_test_memnn_backcomp: run the test_backcomp test to verify memnn model files maintain accuracy and f1 scores over time
run_test_memnn_suite: run the full TestMemnn unittest suite to validate memnn model training and backward compatibility
test_memnn_model_training: test the memnn model training with SGD optimizer on integration_tests:overfit task for 100 epochs
eval_memnn_model_checkpoint: eval the pretrained memnn model checkpoint from zoo:unittest/memnn/model on integration_tests task
